title: branch.stale payload v1
description: A PR branch is older than process.branch_max_age_h: its first event on the PR channel (opened_at) is that old when a trigger event (pr.pushed, pr.ready) is appended. Evaluated on the event, never on a clock (P-32); one event per branch, by its natural key.

opened_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC occurred_at of the branch's first event on its PR channel.

age_h.description: Hours between opened_at and the injected clock when the trigger was appended.

max_age_h.description: The process.branch_max_age_h in force when the event was emitted.
